audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet chart (Olaf x4, Skill, Skill, Ornn) and with the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[3] says 'His axes out-poke you levels 4-5' while the chart rendered Skill; whys[4] opens with the literal word 'Skill window' while the chart rendered Olaf; whys[6] says you out-durable him and become the anchor while the chart rendered Olaf. The mirror re-proposed exactly this chart as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Row 3 Skill -> Olaf (3/10), row 4 Olaf -> Skill (5/10), row 6 Olaf -> Ornn (6/10), in BOTH layers as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes never gave Ragnarok's cooldown and never noted that Olaf's power curve falls, which is the reason row 6 belongs to Ornn.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s. Olaf is an early bully whose kit has no scaling tool, against Ornn's level-13 Masterwork upgrades.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Olaf — Undertow online, Ragnarok at 6 (100s), first item, then he falls off. Ornn — level 3 for Bellows Breath, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2 items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (1) The page repeatedly attributed true damage to Ragnarok — 'his R gives CC-immunity and true damage', 'his axes deal true damage through your shield'. True damage comes from Reckless Swing (E), a 325-range single hit, and Ragnarok grants no damage type at all. (2) The page said 'his R only ignores CC for a few seconds', but Riot's text is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — there is no fixed duration.
audit.why: Both errors point the player at the wrong counterplay. Believing the ult carries the true damage makes you fear his ult window and ignore his E; believing the immunity is a short timer makes you wait it out standing still, when the actual answer is to break his attack chain — walk out of range, put the pillar between you, and the immunity lapses. Also never named: Undertow (1000 range, flat 9s) reduces Armor and Move Speed and 'if Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset', so the axe on the ground is a live cooldown you can make him walk for. Berserker Rage scales attack speed and lifesteal off MISSING health, so a long brawl favours him by design. Tough It Out is 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: True damage re-attributed to Reckless Swing with its 325 range; Ragnarok restated as attack-gated disable immunity on 100s; Undertow's reset-on-pickup and Berserker Rage's missing-health scaling added.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked only 'CC-immune — your knockup won't hold him' with no numbers.
audit.why: Undertow's flat 9s never changes with rank but resets entirely on pickup, which is the single most useful cooldown fact in the lane and was absent.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries Ragnarok 100s with its attack condition and Undertow 9s with the reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build armor + anti-heal' but carried a copy of tradeGood.
audit.why: Armour is specifically the wrong buy against Reckless Swing's true damage — the rule needed to say so, and to tie the anti-heal to Berserker Rage's missing-health lifesteal.
audit.corrected: That rule now states armour does nothing against the true damage and prioritises Grievous Wounds.

notes: Two factual errors fixed that a player would act on. (1) True damage was attributed to Ragnarok in three strings; it is Reckless Swing (E), 325 range, and it costs Olaf health unless it kills. (2) The page said Ragnarok 'only ignores CC for a few seconds' — Riot's text has no duration: 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'. The real counterplay is breaking his attack chain, not waiting out a timer, and that is now stated in five places. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Ornn's pillar physically blocks Olaf from reaching him to sustain Ragnarok (plausible, not in the text), whether tenacity or QSS interacts with the immunity, and whether Undertow's pickup reset works while the axe is in a wall.
